faqs.question: What does 🍝❤️ mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy, 🍝❤️ is a flirty reply — the partner-coded cue is usually aimed at a specific recipient. In tight group chats it can read as buddy energy, but DMs make the read obvious.

faqs.question: Is 🍝❤️ appropriate for work?
faqs.answer: Skip 🍝❤️ in work channels. The flirting-coded cue is the wrong register for professional threads unless the relationship with the recipient is explicitly non-work.

faqs.question: Is 🍝❤️ just a friend thing?
faqs.answer: 🍝❤️ is not just a friend thing. The combo is most common between two people who are already flirting, dating, or signaling attraction; in tight friend-only groups it can read as buddy energy.

faqs.question: Is 🍝❤️ a green flag?
faqs.answer: 🍝❤️ is generally a green flag in a new connection — it signals attraction without pressure. Whether it stays a green flag depends on how the recipient reads the rest of the conversation.
